g.text: A different pocket, the same exit
Three reflections in a triangle can be replaced by one in a square.
All displayed paths use exact coordinates.

g.text: Same entry, same exit, same directions

g.text: Only the part of the path inside the pocket changes. Every later segment can stay exactly as it was.
These conditions keep all reflection points away from corners.
